decisions.reason: Its visible continuation and strong referenced government adoption suggest performance comfortably above aspiration levels, so a large firm with slack is very unlikely to withdraw it.

Although no concrete market results are shown, its survival on a dedicated page through 2024 indicates at least satisfactory strategic fit and enough organisational slack to continue while demand information develops.

Because it remained actively marketed through 2024 and complements the firm’s travel-security verification activities, management would likely keep it unless upcoming results fall clearly below aspiration.
